release: CoreSpirit v82 — chart runtime decomposition + external high-frequency data path

chart_runtime.react_policy: market ticks do not enter LiveChart React state

chart consumers are isolated by broker + instrument key
CoreSpirit runtime and VM architecture remain unchanged
verification: focused TypeScript checks where frontend dependencies are available
